title: Conjecture on the number of ideals in C-vines
statement:
Let a C-vine have dimension $\ell
greater than or equal to1$, and let $N_\ell$ denote its number of ideals.

**C-vine ideal-count conjecture.** The number of ideals in the C-vine of dimension $\ell\ge1$ is given by the OEIS sequence A047970:

$$
N_\ell=\sum_{i=0}^\ell\left((i+1)^{\ell-i}-i^{\ell-i}\right).
$$

This conjecture arises from calculations for C-vines. The general problem of counting ideals in arbitrary R-vines is stated to remain open, while the corresponding count for D-vines is known to be the Catalan number.
source_name: Hung Manh Tran, Tan Nhat Tran and Shuhei Tsujie, “Vines and MAT-labeled graphs”, arXiv:2311.17793 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17793

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2023).
